descartados.titulo: A novel in-vitro skin model to assess secondary transfer of applied testosterone following skin to skin contact.
descartados.extracto: Transdermal testosterone gels are popular and widely used for testosterone replacement therapy. However, unintended exposure of other individuals to testosterone through secondary transfer of the product caused by skin-to-skin contact is a recognised risk with their use. Case reports have described children developing clinical symptoms following inadvertent transfer, despite controlled in vivo studies generally suggesting that secondary transfer is minimal once the gel has dried. descartados.titulo: An integrative roadmap for a new era of kidney replacement therapies.
descartados.extracto: Innovation in kidney replacement is entering a transformative era. descartados.titulo: A role for SUMO activating enzyme-2 in human cancer transformation models reveals regulation of self-renewal and induced differentiation
descartados.extracto: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are a rare subset of tumor cells that initiate and sustain tumor regrowth and are associated with chemotherapy resistance leading to patient relapse. descartados.titulo: A stepwise fresh porcine head model for three-dimensional dissection of ventricular, limbic, and deep venous anatomy
descartados.extracto: Deep ventricular, limbic, cisternal, and deep venous structures form a compact three-dimensional anatomical system that is difficult to understand from two-dimensional resources alone. We evaluated the technical feasibility of organizing fresh ex vivo porcine heads into a four-module, stepwise dissection model for demonstrating these relationships. Five porcine heads obtained from a regulated food supply chain were prepared without formalin fixation, vascular injection, or specialized laboratory equipment. descartados.titulo: Alveolar Type II Cell-derived MMP1high basal cells promote destructive microcysts in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
descartados.extracto: Alveolar microcysts, a hallmark of Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF), are basal cell (BC)-lined structures that develop near terminal airways and correlate with poor clinical outcomes. Lineage switch (LS) is a rare but aggressive immunophenotypic transformation of acute leukemia associated with limited therapeutic options and poor clinical outcome. Although LS has been increasingly recognized in the era of CD19-directed immunotherapies, its biological basis remains incompletely understood. Most reported pediatric LS cases occur in KMT2A -rearranged ( KMT2A -r) leukemia, highlighting a link between developmental origin and lineage plasticity. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview of the clinical, molecular, epigenetic, and cellular determinants of pediatric LS.

descartados.titulo: Common transcriptional changes in the brain during hibernation and Alzheimer's disease
descartados.extracto: Hibernation demands rapid brain adaptations, involving cycles of reduced metabolic rate during torpor, followed by brief periods of arousal. Previous studies show hibernation induces a drastic increase in Tau hyperphosphorylation, but a mechanistic connection to disease remains unclear. descartados.extracto: Alzheimer's disease (AD) research has accomplished significant strides in recent years, particularly with the first regulatory approvals of disease-modifying therapies and a comprehensive revision of disease diagnostic criteria. descartados.titulo: Phosphonic, arsonic, stibonic, and bismuthonic acids: a unified perspective on a fragmented family of group 15 oxyacids
descartados.extracto: Organopnictonic acids are compounds with the general formula RPnO 3 H 2 where Pn = P, As, Sb, Bi. They comprise a family of compounds with many useful properties and also provide a powerful framework for understanding fundamental periodic trends in bonding, structure, and reactivity across group 15. In this review, we present a comprehensive and critical perspective on phosphonic, arsonic, stibonic, and bismuthonic acids, covering the development of the field from its earliest foundations to the present day and, for the first time, unifying these oxyacids within a single conceptual framework.
